en.headline: Hang Seng Index closes 3.67 percent higher at 24796.98
en.dek: Hong Kong stocks rose nearly 880 points on Thursday, with the Hang Seng Tech Index gaining 5.55 percent amid broad strength in technology shares.
body: The Hang Seng Index closed 3.67 percent higher on Thursday at 24,796.98, up about 877 points from the previous close of 23,919.50.

The Hang Seng Tech Index rose 5.55 percent and the Hang Seng China Enterprises Index gained 3.87 percent. Technology and internet shares led gains, with NetEase up more than 9 percent and Alibaba and Xiaomi each rising more than 8 percent. Auto stocks also advanced, while oil shares declined.
The market opened higher and held gains through the session, with the index touching a high near 24,872 during the day. Turnover was robust as investors responded to regional and global developments.

zh.headline: 恒生指數收市升3.67%報24796.98點
zh.dek: 港股周四上升近880點，恒生科技指數升5.55%，科網股普遍造好。
body: 恒生指數周四收市報24,796.98點，上升3.67%，約升877點，上日收市為23,919.50點。
恒生科技指數升5.55%，國企指數升3.87%。科網股領漲，網易升逾9%，阿里巴巴及小米各升逾8%。汽車股亦表現強勁，石油股則回軟。
大市高開後全日保持升勢，盤中最高見近24,872點。成交活躍，投資者對地區及環球消息作出反應。
